scheme_name: One Time Cash Incentive towards Learning Driving (Sainik Welfare)
other_conditions: Applicant must be registered with the Department of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry.
Applicant must obtain prior permission from the Department of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry to take the course.
Applicant must apply within three years of discharge from service.
Driving course must be taken from a Government-recognized school/institution.
benefits_summary: One-time cash incentive of ₹4,000 credited to the beneficiary’s bank account.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self-attested, if required)
